initialize_llava_onevision_video_process: initialize the LLaVa-OneVision video processor with default resize, normalization, and rescale settings
configure_video_frame_sampling: configure the LLaVa-OneVision video processor to sample frames from video input sequences
resize_video_frames_to_384: resize video frames to 384x384 pixels using bicubic interpolation for LLaVa-OneVision input
normalize_video_frames_with_clip_stats: normalize video frames using OpenAI CLIP mean and standard deviation values
rescale_video_pixel_values: rescale video pixel values by dividing by 255 to normalize to 0-1 range
